# Public XTCE documents that `make samples-check` downloads into files/.
# Each line: the local name, the SHA-256 of the file, and its URL, pinned to
# a commit so that the expected results in expected.txt stay valid.
#
#   yamcs     test documents of Yamcs (https://github.com/yamcs/yamcs)
#   xtcetools test documents and examples of the XTCE Toolkit
#             (https://github.com/CesarCoelho/xtcetools)
#   yamcs-examples   the mission databases of Yamcs's examples: PUS services,
#                    a lander simulation and the packet viewer
#   yamcs-xtce       test documents of Yamcs's XTCE loader
#   yamcs-quickstart the mission database of the Yamcs quickstart
#                    (https://github.com/yamcs/quickstart)
#   yamcs-cfs        cFS (airliner) mission databases for Yamcs
#                    (https://github.com/WindhoverLabs/yamcs-cfs)
